$comment: silences one npm-audit top-level finding for one dependency tree.
tree      - one of the trees audited by audit-dependencies.js:
package   - the top-level package name as reported by `npm audit --json`
(the key under `vulnerabilities`, not necessarily the vulnerable
leaf package if the finding is transitive)
severity  - informational; the severity npm reported at the time the entry
was added, so drift (npm reporting a different/worse severity
reason    - REQUIRED. Why this is safe to ship unpatched right now.
reviewBy  - REQUIRED. ISO date this suppression must be re-examined by.
A suppression here means 'known, judged acceptable for now' — not 'fixed'.
Findings that are actually patched should have the fix applied and the
